title: Non-disclosure agreement; incident made classified
place_text: Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota

tellings.quote: but then Jack Reed walked over and handed him this other piece of paper as he was putting mine down and it was uh an like a non-disclosure agreement

plain: Mario Woods, a former guard of nuclear weapons at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota who says he was abducted by a UFO, says that in 1977, after his incident, a man named Jack Reed walked over and handed another piece of paper across as Woods's own paper was being set down: a non-disclosure agreement, a pledge to keep quiet. Woods says the whole incident was then made classified, and also names a Colonel Spraker as part of the scene. He tells it as something he went through himself, as evidence that the Air Force wanted the event kept secret.
